tools.name: enerflo_get_company
tools.description: Return the company that owns the API key (id, name, contact, address, slug). Good first call. Enerflo API: GET /v3/authcheck.

tools.name: enerflo_list_offices
tools.description: List the offices of the company. Enerflo API: GET /v3/offices.

tools.name: enerflo_list_loan_products
tools.description: List the finance options (lenders and loan products) of the company. Enerflo API: GET /v3/loan-products.

tools.name: enerflo_list_products
tools.description: List products (equipment and adders) of the company or of authorized companies. Enerflo API: GET /v3/company/products.

tools.name: enerflo_list_install_statuses
tools.description: List all possible install project statuses. Enerflo API: GET /v3/install-statuses.

tools.name: enerflo_list_users
tools.description: List users of the company (and of authorized companies when company_id is not set). Enerflo API: GET /v3/users.

tools.name: enerflo_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by Enerflo user id. Enerflo API: GET /v3/users/{id}.

tools.name: enerflo_list_customers
tools.description: List customers and leads. The search term matches name, email or phone. Use pageSize and page for large lists. Enerflo API: GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: enerflo_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by Enerflo customer id. Enerflo API: GET /v3/customers/{id}.

tools.name: enerflo_list_customer_notes
tools.description: List all notes of a customer. Enerflo API: GET /v3/customers/{id}/notes.

tools.name: enerflo_list_customer_appointments
tools.description: List all appointments of a customer. Enerflo API: GET /v3/customers/{id}/appointments.

tools.name: enerflo_list_customer_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of one customer. Enerflo API: GET /v1/tasks/{customerId}.

tools.name: enerflo_list_installs
tools.description: List install projects (default 25 per page, newest first). Optional single filter on one field, for example status_name eq 'Permitting'. Enerflo API: GET /v3/installs.

tools.name: enerflo_get_install
tools.description: Get one install project: company, customer, milestones and uploaded files. Enerflo API: GET /v3/installs/{id}.

tools.name: enerflo_find_install
tools.description: Find the install record of a customer. Give exactly one of customer_id or survey_id. Enerflo API: GET /v1/search/find_install.

tools.name: enerflo_list_install_notes
tools.description: List install notes of the company, newest first, with optional filters. Enerflo API: GET /v3/installs/notes.

tools.name: enerflo_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks of the whole company. Optional single filter, for example completed eq 0. Enerflo API: GET /v3/tasks/all.

tools.name: enerflo_add_customer_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a customer record. Each call creates a new note (not idempotent). Enerflo API: POST /v3/customers/{id}/notes.

tools.name: enerflo_add_install_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to an install project. Each call creates a new note (not idempotent). Set customer_facing to true only when the customer may read it in the customer portal. Enerflo API: POST /v3/installs/{id}/notes.

tools.name: enerflo_add_lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer/lead in Enerflo. Each call may create a new record (not idempotent): search with enerflo_list_customers first to avoid duplicates. Enerflo API: POST /v1/partner/action/lead/add.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: enerflo_list_customers, enerflo_add_install_note, enerflo_add_lead · Private data: enerflo_get_company, enerflo_get_install, enerflo_find_install, enerflo_add_customer_note, enerflo_add_lead · Public sink: enerflo_list_customers, enerflo_add_customer_note, enerflo_add_install_note, enerflo_add_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: enerflo_list_customers, enerflo_add_install_note, enerflo_add_lead · Private data: enerflo_get_company, enerflo_get_install, enerflo_find_install, enerflo_add_customer_note, enerflo_add_lead · Public sink: enerflo_list_customers, enerflo_add_customer_note, enerflo_add_install_note, enerflo_add_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
